title: Hinomori Shiho — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shiho's birthday
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... The cake plates are all set, which just leaves the decorations for my room!

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Shizuku, can we talk for a second...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, you're pretty much done...
I was going to ask if there was anything I can do to help...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, it's your special day.
You shouldn't have to lift a finger.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get that, but you really didn't have to go this far for me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, all I did for your birthday was give you that pass case...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I think I understand... Are you saying that because I didn't have all my friends over for my birthday?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, kinda...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see... But you don't have to feel that way. This party's not actually just for you, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how you sort of preferred to play all by yourself when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I absolutely admire how you're such a strong girl, but you also seem so lonely at times looking in from the outside...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, seeing you have Ichika and Minori along with so many other friends and classmates around you now puts such a big smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course, this birthday party is meant to celebrate you, Shii, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to throw this party to also ask everyone, “Please keep looking after Shii.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Look after me...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, point taken...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. So please, let me celebrate your special day by throwing you this party. Are you still okay with that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm okay with it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all for gathering today to celebrate Shii's birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Here's to her having so many friends to look after her now! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku! You couldn't just go with “Happy birthday”?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho♪
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks.
To be fair, we already did this once yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know.
But we've got a surprise ready for you today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We invited Tsukasa and Emu to join us today, but they, unfortunately, said they're both busy with a show at the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lucky for us, they recorded a voice message for us! Let's listen to it together later♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Allow us to say it again.
Happy birthday, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I really appreciate it. Thank you all for coming today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks for inviting us.
Also, about your present...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We ran into Kohane while out looking for something to get you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! That was when the three of us decided to get you something together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ta-daah! Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: W-Wait, this is...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's a limited-edition Phenny set that you could only get abroad and still hasn't been re-released.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I knew it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wanted to get this when I saw that you could have them use inner tubes or surf together, but I thought it was out of my reach forever.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shiho, do you know Emu?
She performs in shows at Phoenix Wonderland, but she's also...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know. Saki's brother introduced me to her... Not only that, her family's the one that runs PXL, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We asked her about this set knowing in advance that we didn't have much of a shot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But then, she discovered that they still had the display sample and was able to get it to us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I had no idea...
Also, this is beyond rare now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Emu said that she'd rather see it in the hands of someone who'll take good care of it instead of having it sit in storage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why we're hoping that you'll give them the love they deserve, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks. I promise to do just that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii seems to be enjoying herself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I could say the same for you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because I'm happy as long as I know that she's smiling.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I can tell. That means we should help give her the celebration that she really deserves!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<Is it recording...? Ahem...!
Shiho, we won't be able to make your party, but we hope you'll get a chance to hear this! Happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Oh, Tsukasa, me next!
Shiho, I know that we have to keep practicing really hard, but I wanna get better so I promise to do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Shiho. I promise to keep doing my best so that the songs we write and play do well during shows... Some words of encouragement might be nice every so often too. Anyway, Honami, you're next...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Okay.
Shiho, thank you for being there to discuss my worries not just regarding our band, but school as well.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <But I want to become stronger so that you can rely on me more! Okay, Emu, your turn.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Yay! Happy wonderhoy birthday, Shiho! Come to Phoenix Wonderland again, okay?! Tsukasa, the others and I will always be there to welcome you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Ready...?>

rows.Speaker: Minori, Kohane & Haruka
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Shiho!>
<Happy birthday, Hinomori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<To Shiho!
You're usually really cool and calm, but I hope the cute girl inside that loves adorable things never goes away♪>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Hehe. I really love being able to talk so much about music with you, Shiho. I'd like it if we could talk more about girl bands sometime!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Even though it was fairly brief, I really enjoyed talking about Phenny with you. I'm sure we both still have plenty more to discuss, so we should definitely chat again!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Shiho!
It's incredible how mature you are. Honestly, I sometimes think you're really the big sister.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Still, Shizuku really is a wonderful big sister, so please throw her a bone every once in a while.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Are you enjoying your birthday party, Shii? I know that I certainly am!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I'm sure that you are, but I'm also sure that your friends are as well. Hehe. I'd like to do this again if possible.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for celebrating my birthday with me today...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Leo/need's still pretty rough around the edges since we're still just getting started as a band...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But Ichika and the others showed me that they're serious about going pro together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why I've gotta keep doing my best too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hope you'll stick around to see what happens.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll see you later.
